C1817.title: Tencent Keen Lab Tesla Model S Remote Intrusion
C1817.summary: In September 2016, Tencent Keen Security Lab remotely intruded a Tesla Model S from distance, by tricking the owner into connecting to a malicious Wi-Fi hotspot and visiting a malicious site via the in-car browser, gaining CAN bus control to remotely trigger braking, lock/unlock doors, adjust seats, and control lights. Tesla pushed OTA v8.0 with code-signing. This was the first publicly disclosed Tesla remote-control attack, presented at Black Hat USA 2016.
